answer: I would stop farms with single-use capability with a nullifier, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 504 aliases need 504 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. One wharf of signal, one harbor of cost, one ledge of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
